title: Software Developer
summary: Design, build, and maintain software applications that solve problems for users and organizations.

title: Web Developer
summary: Create and update websites and web applications, including layout, functionality, and performance.

title: Data Scientist
summary: Analyze large datasets with statistics and machine learning to answer questions and guide decisions.

title: Information Security Analyst
summary: Protect computer systems and networks by finding risks and putting safeguards in place.

title: Database Administrator
summary: Store, organize, and secure an organization's data so applications and people can use it reliably.

title: UX Designer
summary: Shape how people move through digital products so interfaces are clear, usable, and satisfying.

title: Graphic Designer
summary: Create visual designs such as logos, layouts, and marketing graphics for print and digital use.

title: Industrial Designer
summary: Design the form and function of physical products so they are useful, manufacturable, and appealing.

title: Animator
summary: Bring characters, motion graphics, and visual effects to life for film, games, and digital media.

title: Market Research Analyst
summary: Study what customers want and how markets are changing so organizations can plan products and campaigns.

title: Product Manager
summary: Decide what a product should do next and coordinate design, engineering, and business work to ship it.

title: Accountant
summary: Prepare and review financial records so organizations understand their money and meet reporting rules.

title: Management Analyst
summary: Study how an organization works and recommend practical ways to improve its operations.

title: Human Resources Specialist
summary: Recruit employees and support hiring, workplace policies, and day-to-day people operations.

title: Counselor
summary: Help people work through emotional, behavioral, and life challenges through counseling and support plans.

title: Clinical Psychologist
summary: Assess and treat mental, emotional, and behavioral conditions using psychological science.

title: School Psychologist
summary: Support students' learning and mental health by assessing needs and working with families and schools.

title: Industrial-Organizational Psychologist
summary: Apply psychology to the workplace to improve hiring, teamwork, motivation, and job design.

title: Social Media Specialist
summary: Plan and publish social content that builds an organization's public voice and audience engagement.

title: Journalist
summary: Research, report, and write news stories that inform the public about events and issues.

title: Technical Writer
summary: Turn complex technical information into clear instructions, guides, and documentation.

title: Editor
summary: Review and revise writing so publications are accurate, clear, and ready for an audience.

title: Biologist
summary: Study living organisms and biological systems through observation, experiments, and data.

title: Chemist
summary: Investigate the composition and behavior of substances and develop or test chemical products.

title: Environmental Scientist
summary: Study air, water, and land conditions and recommend ways to protect human health and the environment.

title: Medical Scientist
summary: Conduct research on human health and disease to improve understanding, treatments, and prevention.

title: Teacher
summary: Plan lessons and teach secondary school subjects while supporting students' academic growth.

title: Elementary School Teacher
summary: Teach foundational reading, math, and other subjects to children in elementary grades.

title: Special Education Teacher
summary: Adapt instruction for students with disabilities so they can learn and meet their educational goals.

title: Instructional Coordinator
summary: Develop curriculum and coach educators on teaching methods, materials, and school-wide learning goals.
